findings.rule: Functional bores on mating/wear parts require a tolerance or fit class to ensure proper assembly and function.

findings.rule: Holes should not be drilled significantly deeper than standard drill-bit geometry allows without special processes; depth-to-diameter ratios above 5:1 are difficult, and 8:1 requires deep-hole drilling.
findings.reasoning: Feature F4 specifies a ⌀5 hole (D14) that is 40 mm deep (D15), giving an 8:1 depth-to-diameter ratio. A standard twist drill cannot reliably produce this without peck drilling, specialized gun-drilling equipment, or risk of bit breakage and severe drift.
findings.correction: Reduce the hole depth if functionally possible, specify a deep-hole drilling process (e.g., gun drill), or increase the diameter to bring the L/D ratio within standard drilling limits (≤5:1).
